question: Since NFA-A retained less capacity than the NCA reference after 100 cycles, by how many percentage points did it fall behind?
rendered:

Capacity retention of NFA-A after 100 cycles = 80%
Capacity retention of NCA after 100 cycles = 68%

Difference in capacity retention = (Capacity retention of NFA-A after 100 cycles - Capacity retention of NCA after 100 cycles) / Capacity retention of NCA after 100 cycles
= (80% - 68%) / 68%
= 12% / 68%
= 0.176 or approximately 17.6%

So, NFA-A fell behind the NCA reference by approximately 17.6 percentage points after 100 cycles.
